hero.title: Public Health in Finland
hero.subtitle: Study Public Health in Finland to explore epidemiology, global health policy, biostatistics, and preventive healthcare in a leading Nordic academic environment.

overview: For Indian students interested in Public Health abroad, Finland offers internationally oriented Master of Public Health (MPH) and health sciences programmes at leading research universities such as the University of Eastern Finland (UEF) and the University of Helsinki.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide assists students in exploring Public Health in Finland, understanding admission criteria, and planning their study-abroad journey.
